reading_note: The arc moves from the structure of perception to its source. Four forms in the eye (the understanding) plus a fifth hidden one correspond to the discrete degrees of reception in the intellectual faculty, with the inmost degree concealed from the outer ones. Four further hidden things in the body (the natural plane) parallel them. The teaching contrasts what is visible to the natural eye and what only the Living Air (interior perception/spiritual breath) sees. The pupil of the eye that sees by day but not by night becomes the central image: spiritual sight functions only when divine light is present; without it, even the most sensitive faculty fails. The mystery resolves at the climax: the gate, the upper and lower regions, and the descent of the First Man (divine truth) who knows all things — meaning the understanding's whole apparatus only operates because divine truth has descended into it from the Living Spirit.
